label: CubeSat terminals, 80 mm (Naughton 2019), with Micius's source
source: Naughton et al., Opt. Eng. 58(1), 016106 (2019), doi:10.1117/1.OE.58.1.016106: terminals designed for an inter-satellite link between two 6U CubeSats
note: A terminal pair sized for a 6U CubeSat, designed for 'satellite separations up to around 400 km' and, with its tracking design, 'likely ... 100 to 150 km'. Their link is entanglement-based; this model runs decoy BB84, so the source is Micius's (an assumption). It shows what small terminals cost at the spacing of a plane.

tx_divergence_urad.assumption: Naughton: 'The beam divergence (lambda = 760 nm) is 6.1 urad at the 1/e2 intensity values ... The beam divergence is half of the full beam angular dimension', so 12.2 urad full. A Gaussian beam puts 2 (D / theta r)^2 on its axis, which this model's top-hat law gives at 12.2 / sqrt(2) urad

rx_aperture_m.assumption: Naughton: 'a clear aperture of 80 mm and a 13% obscuration produced by the secondary mirror'; read as 13 percent of the area, the conservative reading, an equivalent 0.08 x sqrt(0.87) m

receiver_optics_efficiency.quote: with an assumed average optical transmission factor of 0.7
receiver_optics_efficiency.note: The receiving side's; the transmitting side's is inside the source intensity, which Liao 2017 gives at the output of the telescope.

pointing_db.assumption: Naughton models pointing as beam jitter rather than a fixed loss; Liao 2017's downlink bound, less than 3 dB, is used

detector_efficiency.assumption: Not stated for their APDs; Xinglong's, efficiency 50% (Liao 2017)

dark_count_prob.assumption: Not stated as a rate; Xinglong's (Liao 2017). Naughton cools the APDs to suppress dark counts

misalignment.assumption: Liao 2017's measured average QBER, 1.1%, carried over

source_rate_hz.assumption: Micius's 100 MHz decoy source (Liao 2017); Naughton's own source is entangled pairs, which this model does not run

clearance_km.assumption: As for the Micius-type profile: the line of sight passes at least 100 km above the ground

eclipse_only.assumption: As Vergoossen et al. assume for every terminal; Naughton's link budget treats stray light separately
